findings.failure_mode: An UNCLOSED fence hiding a second `## Risk\nassertive` below a visible `## Risk\nreversible` still yields reversible, so a classified-but-ambiguous risk closes on the lenient bar (codex:terra).

Closing-hash normalization exists only on the risk path: `## Blocked ##` / `## Handoff ##` (valid ATX) make _live_section_span and _extract_block_reason return None, so writers append duplicates and readers miss the section (sonnet, codex:sol, codex:terra convergent).
The reader-fail-open / writer-fail-closed asymmetry on a handoff under an unclosed fence is disclosed by design but unpinned by any test (opus#2; test-only accept).

known_rejects.claim: a bare empty `##` heading returns None from _atx_h2_text
known_rejects.why_rejected: A bare `##` never matches any real section title, so it has no consequence; not applicable.
